newsitem.title: FRANCE: IRAN BUYS 50,000 TONNES OCT BARLEY AT AROUND $125.
newsitem.headline: IRAN BUYS 50,000 TONNES OCT BARLEY AT AROUND $125.

text.p: Iran on Wednesday bought 50,000 tonnes of barley at around $125/tonne, European grain traders said.
The grain is to be shipped in October.

Iran bought the barley under a same-day tender issued on Tuesday. The tender called for barley of optional origin though grain from the United States, Germany, Britain or Norway -- countries with which Tehran has strained ties -- was said to be excluded.
European traders put the price around $124 to $125 per tonne, although one report put it at $125.50 fob.
France and, depending on availability, Canada are included among the potential suppliers, traders said.
